thread:
maya: Quick async check — Qtr OKR milestone spotlight for cross-stack infra: what shipped, what slipped, and immediate next steps. Posting concise owners so we can roll forward.

aj: Thanks — short list from infra side: shipped: runtime v3 batcher hotfix (deployed canary -> 100% last week). owner: aj. slipped: autoscale rule tuning for Dedicated (blocked by infra quota limits). owner: ravi (fs). next steps: ravi to confirm cloud quota request status and assign fallbacks.

ravi: Confirmed quota request submitted yesterday to cloud-ops; pending approval ETA 48h, flagged escalation if no OK by EOW. If quota not approved we will enable temporary burst nodes in eu-west and route non-critical traffic.

sloan: From product: shipped: API schema v2 for function-calling (docs + SDK). owner: sloan. slipped: rollout of new telemetry tags for per-route cost breakdown — slipped because SDK change required. owner: ellie. next: ellie will open a small PR to the SDK with tag parsing and we can ship telemetry change in next patch.

ellie: PR is open: github.com/redwood/clients/pull/4123 — pinged reviewers @maya @sloan. I expect merge within 24-36h if no blockers.

maya: Thanks. Two cross-team asks: 1) we need an explicit canary rollback plan for the autoscale tuning change (if quota later fails). 2) owners for verification tests for telemetry tags (unit + e2e).

aj: For canary rollback plan: aj -> create a short runbook (commands + monitoring thresholds) and post here. I can pair with ravi for the infra side.

ravi: I'll update the cloud-ops ticket with fallback plan and add runbook link.

sloan: Verification tests: ellie for unit, maya for e2e + perf. Ellie, can you add a small test matrix in the PR?

ellie: Yep — adding unit tests + a lightweight e2e assertion against the telemetry ingest in staging. ETA: tomorrow morning.

maya: Great. Also code-review pings: please review PRs below so nothing blocks ship window: 
- infra: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/598 (autoscale changes) — reviewer: aj, sloan for product impact
- sdk: github.com/redwood/clients/pull/4123 (telemetry tags) — reviewer: maya, ravi
- runtime: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/2311 (kv cache tweak) — reviewer: ellie, aj

ella?: (typo) ignore

deploy-bot: Canaries running: runtime-v3-batcher canary (id: canary-20260315-7) -> 2% traffic. No error spikes in 30m.

aj: Note: runtime-v3-batcher PR has a small perf regression on 512 token requests (~2% latency). I've scheduled a short perf patch; will open PR later today. Keeping canary at 2% until patch lands.

sloan: Is the 2% perf regression acceptable for product SLOs? we should quantify impact on tail latency customers.

aj: Not for tail-99.9 latency. It's measured at p95 -> 2% increase; p99 unaffected so far. We'll push patch and re-evaluate.

maya: Action summary: 
- ravi: follow up cloud quota escalation + post fallback nodes plan (by EOD).
- aj: runbook for canary rollback + perf patch PR (today).
- ellie: add tests to SDK PR & merge (tomorrow AM).
- maya + sloan: confirm telemetry regression alerts + update dashboards after SDK merge.

ravi: Acknowledged. I'll comment in the infra PR and link cloud ticket.

ellie: Acknowledged, reviewing now.

sloan: Great. If nobody has objections, we'll treat this as the canonical async update for the milestone. Please react with :thumbsup: when done or add follow-up comments.

maya: :thumbsup:
